query:
SELECT 
  c.id AS contact_id,
  c.name AS contact_name,
  ccf.id AS field_id,
  ccf.fieldName,
  ccf.fieldValue,
  ccf.createdAt
FROM contacts c
INNER JOIN users u ON c.parentUserId = u.id
LEFT JOIN contact_custom_fields ccf ON c.id = ccf.contactId
WHERE u.username = 'Jiang' AND c.name = '羊仲平';
